comment_text.value: New C is old B? https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B_(programming_language) I implemented some examples using B language. I like its typeless and simplicity. It would be nice if there was a modern and mature implementation of this language, it's a true portable assembler.

author: paul_ch
